title: Technical/Product Publications, Sr Engineer
description:
**We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
**You Are**
A technical writer with experience in turning complex technical information into documentation that people actually read, not just files that sit in a repository.
  
  
You have worked in DITA XML, you understand topics and maps, and you know why content reuse saves more than just time. When a product manager/SME hands you half-formed specs and a developer gives you a code comment as context, you do not wait for perfection. You ask the right questions, dig into the product yourself, and build something clear from the pieces you have.
  
  
You are detail-oriented and can review documents for consistency and catch the terminology drift that everyone else missed. At Synopsys, you will work on customer-facing documentation for products that power semiconductor development worldwide, and what you write will directly affect how engineers understand and use those tools.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Create and maintain customer documentation using DITA XML in Adobe FrameMaker or Oxygen XML, structuring content for reuse, modularity, and multi-format publishing
* Work directly with developers, product managers, QA engineers, and SMEs to collect technical information, validate accuracy, and drive documentation reviews through to sign-off
* Analyze product functionality and translate it into task-based, user-focused documentation that helps engineers solve real problems
* Review and edit documentation for technical accuracy, grammar, terminology consistency, and adherence to Synopsys style guidelines
* Manage documentation updates aligned with product release schedules, ensuring content is versioned, tracked, and delivered on time
* Create and maintain supporting content such as screenshots, diagrams, workflows, tables, and illustrations.
* Identify gaps and inconsistencies in existing documentation and contribute to process improvements, templates, and authoring standards

**The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable customers to adopt and use Synopsys EDA and IP products more effectively through clear, accurate documentation
* Reduce support escalations by ensuring engineers can find answers in the docs instead of filing tickets
* Improve documentation consistency and reusability across product lines, making updates faster and reducing duplication
* Accelerate product launches by delivering documentation that meets release milestones without blocking engineering timelines
* Strengthen the quality bar for technical content across the organization by contributing to standards, templates, and peer reviews
* Help shape how Synopsys leverages structured authoring and emerging tools like AI to scale documentation efforts
* Build documentation that holds up under real-world use, not just passes internal review

**What You'll Need**

* 2 to 4 years of professional experience in technical writing, ideally for software or technology products
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent discipline
* Hands-on experience with DITA XML concepts including topics, maps, content reuse, conditional content, and cross-references
* Proficiency in Adobe FrameMaker or Oxygen XML for structured authoring and publishing
* Strong command of technical communication fundamentals like task-based writing, information architecture, and content structuring
* Familiarity with version control systems such as Git or Perforce for managing documentation source files
* Experience with MS Visio for creating technical diagrams and process flows is a plus, as is exposure to AI tools for content drafting, summarization, or quality improvement

**Who You Are**

* You can sit in a design review with engineers, absorb the technical details, and walk out with a plan for how to document it clearly for three different user personas
* You manage multiple documentation projects and deadlines without missing release dates
* You push back when technical information is incomplete or when a proposed change will confuse users, and you do it in a way that keeps the collaboration moving
* You work independently across time zones and distributed teams, but you also know when to pull people into a review or escalate a blocker
* You care about the details, catching terminology inconsistencies, broken links, and formatting issues that others miss, but you also ship on time
* You are curious about new tools and workflows, whether that means exploring AI-assisted authoring, automation scripts, or better ways to structure content for reuse

**The Team You'll Be Part Of**
Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.
  
  
**Rewards And Benefits**
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process

title: Associate
description:
**Position Summary**
Senior Technical Writer – Technical Communications
  
  
The Senior Technical Writer is responsible for developing, managing, and enhancing complex technical documentation that supports product adoption, customer success, and internal knowledge sharing. Ownership

Communication

title: Subject Matter Expert Mathematics
description:
**Company Description**
Made A Way Pvt Ltd is an education-focused organization dedicated to creating smart, innovative, and economical academic content for learners worldwide. Originating as a YouTube channel in 2017 that supported competitive exam preparation for tests such as GATE, IES, and SSC, the company has grown into a broader content and assessment provider. Its mission is to foster innovative minds by offering high-quality, accessible educational materials. Made A Way develops content for universities, schools, and institutes across diverse subjects including Mathematics, sciences, and engineering disciplines. Services include assessment design, textbook solutions, content creation, video lectures, live Q&A, assignments, and tests.

**Role Description**
The Subject Matter Expert (SME) – Mathematics will work full time on-site at the Noida office. This role involves developing clear, accurate, and concept-driven academic content for Mathematics, including solutions for textbooks, assignments, tests, and competitive exam preparation materials. The SME will design practice questions, assessments, and explanatory notes aligned with various curricula and exam patterns. Daily responsibilities include reviewing and validating mathematical content for accuracy, creating step-by-step solutions, and collaborating with the content and video production teams to support scripts and live sessions. The role also includes updating content based on feedback, maintaining consistency in style and quality, and meeting defined productivity and quality targets.

**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Mathematics with the ability to explain concepts clearly and develop varied question types and solutions.
* Experience in academic content creation, including textbook solutions, assessments, and exam-focused materials for school, university, or competitive exams.
* Proficiency in written English for educational explanations, with attention to logical structuring, clarity, and learner-friendly language.
* Ability to work on-site in Chandigarh, manage deadlines, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional content and production teams.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mathematics or a closely related field;
* Comfort with digital tools for content authoring (e.g., LaTeX, equation editors, learning platforms) and willingness to adapt to new systems.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, high attention to detail, and commitment to creating accurate, learner-centric content.

title: Sr. Project Officer - MELS & Digital Transformation
description:
**Description**
Senior Project Officer: MELS & Digital Transformation
  
  
**Background**
Passing Gifts Private Limited (PGPL) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Heifer International USA and it provides services in educating, consulting, training, advising, and providing professional and technical services to individuals, associations, and entities in India and abroad, particularly those who support or are working in the areas of social advancement and sustainable development. This position may also require service agreements, secondment agreements, between entities, etc.
  
  
PGPL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identify, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.
  
  
**Function**
This position will support the development and manage the implementation of monitoring, evaluation, learning and systems (MELS) and Digital Transformation of the organization. A strong emphasis for this role is on IT enabled system, digital innovation, data collection, ensuring data quality, partner capacity building on MELS, evaluation/survey management, integrity, data analysis, reporting, dissemination, and learnings.
  
  
RESPONSIBILITIES AND DELIVERABLES: (including approximate percentage effort)
  
  
MELS: Implement monitoring, evaluation, learning, and systems for the project. (35%)
  
  

* Lead the implementation of the MELS Plan for the project.
* Review and adjust MELS plans and targets, tools, and processes periodically and update the same.
* Coordinate for annual outcome monitoring/surveys.
* Work with external evaluators to conduct the Baseline, Mid-term and final evaluations while ensuring data quality.
* Conduct and manage the monitoring of project progress, living income validation, and output monitoring as per the MELS plan.
* Ensure the effective implementation of PGPL MELS policies and procedures for the project.
* Disseminate learning findings from project monitoring, evaluation, and research. Lead learning events with key stakeholders within the project communities, implementation partners, and PGPL in general.
* Elevate MELS-related challenges to the Project Director and Associate Director – MELS for coordination with the Executive Country Director to find timely solutions;
* Design data collection tools, plans, and processes for all required information, ensuring high quality and integrity of data.
* Support the development of project frameworks and logical frameworks for all new projects.
* Support in the rollout and manage the PGPL MELS system and IPMS for the projects.

Digital Transformation: Enabling IT, Innovations & IT Support (30%)
  
  

* Lead the integration of the organization's PMIS system with digital dashboards for real-time data visualization and decision-making.
* Develop and implement IT and digital solutions for the organization’s key operational areas, including Self-Help Groups (SHG), Farmer Producer Organizations (FPO), and other livelihood initiatives.
* Build and manage IT-enabled tracking mechanisms for critical program activities such as access to finance, fodder security, farmer field schools etc.
* Guide and support teams in data collection, digital reporting, and IT system optimization to enhance program efficiency.
* Work closely with global teams to customize and improve IT tools, cloud services, and collaboration platforms.
* Support the design and implementation of AI-driven mechanisms for predictive analytics, process automation, and enhanced program monitoring.
* Identify opportunities for AI-driven insights, automation, and efficiency improvements across the organization’s digital ecosystem.
* Promote digital-first approaches for monitoring, evaluation, learning, and reporting to improve data-driven decision-making.
* Stay updated on emerging technologies and assess their applicability to improve workflow automation and program impact.

Project Effectiveness: Data management, Analysis and Support in Data-based decision-making (25%)
  
  

* Conduct and/or quality ensure all MELS data collected for the project.
* Organize routine data quality assessment on a quarterly basis and performance monitoring of each sub-Award on a semi-annual basis.
* Summarize/aggregate/analyze data at the state/project/FOAB/geography level to promote data- based decision-making and support in the program strategy.
* Manage all data properly in clean form, and analyze to use for project management, learnings, and meet all the reporting needs.
* Work with the project management team to respond to periodic clients and PGPL requests for additional information on project activities and results.
* Building capacity of the project partners, program staff and other stakeholders on MELS and related components (PR, LR, Outcome Monitoring).

Sub Award Design and Management (5%)
  
  

* Collaborate with project holders and PGPL teams in project design and MELS budgeting.
* Support in preparation of sub-award proposals.
* Support research and evaluation initiatives in the country.
* Assist in networking with other development organizations, governments and other line agencies in promoting PGPL development model/initiatives, and potential collaborations.
* Track physical and financial project progress against the annual plan.
* Contribute to the recruitment, training, and supervision of external parties that are contracted to implement special surveys and studies required for evaluating project effects and impacts.

May perform other job-related duties as requested (5%)
  
  
**Qualifications And Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in project planning, Monitoring and Management, Economics and/or Statistics, or Social Science and or an equivalent with an academic focus on monitoring and evaluation or another related field; In addition, person should have good understanding about Information Technology (IT).
* Having a minimum of five (5) years of total experience in I/NGOs, out of which a minimum of three (3) years of relevant experience in MELS and research;
* Knowledge and understanding of project Monitoring, Evaluation, Learning, and Result Framework.
* Knowledge of tool development using the ODK platform; SurveyCTO.
* A good knowledge of Advance Excel, SPSS/STATA; Data visualization tools like PowerBI, Tableau etc.
* Experience in the design and usage of digital data collection tools like Survey-CTO, ODK, key surveys, etc.;
* Sound knowledge and skills in project management, MELS plan, result framework, and evaluation management;
* A good knowledge and skills to manage project database management system.

**Essential Competencies**

* Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to navigate challenging situations to achieve goals and deadlines;
* Demonstrate a high degree of honesty and integrity;
* Motivated to work responsibly with little supervision;
* Ability to meet and deal with others in a courteous and tactful manner;
* Ability to work with sensitive information and to always maintain confidentiality;
* Ability and willingness to work a flexible schedule;
* Fluent in Hindi, English, and Local Language spoken as well as written;
* Have an interest in animals/agriculture community development;
* Willingness and ability to travel locally and internationally;
* Knowledge of word processing, spreadsheets, PowerPoint, web designing, collaboration platform and tools, and electronic mail software (Microsoft preferred);
* Constant sitting, standing and walking, with occasional bending and lifting; may work at a computer for extended periods of time.

title: Content Writer
description:

title: Manager - MELS
description:
**Description**
**BACKGROUND:**
Passing Gifts Private Limited (PGPL) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Heifer International USA and it provides services in educating, consulting, training, advising, and providing professional and technical services to individuals, associations, and entities in India and abroad, particularly those who support or are working in the areas of social advancement and sustainable development. This position may also require service agreements, secondment agreements and agreements between entities, etc.
  
  
PGPL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability
  
  
**Function**
The
**Manager – MELS**
will lead the operationalization and strengthening of MELS systems across PGPL’s projects and portfolios. Sitting between the Associate Director – MELS & Program Quality and the MELS Officer/Sr. MELS Officer, the position plays a pivotal role in:
  
  

* Ensuring high-quality MEL planning and execution,
* Leading project-level evaluations and outcome monitoring,
* Driving data quality, analytics, and reporting, and
* Ensuring learning integration across projects and partners.

The Manager – MELS will work with the MELS Officer/Sr. MELS Officer and ensure alignment of their work with project and organizational MEL frameworks. The role bridges strategic direction from the Associate Director with operational execution at the field and project levels.
  
  
RESPONSIBILITIES AND DELIVERABLES: (including approximate percentage effort)
  
  
**Strengthen Monitoring, Evaluation, Learning, and System (MELS) at Organization Level (30%)**

* Lead the development and periodic revision of MEL Plans for all projects, ensuring alignment with the organization’s program model.
* Guide and support the MELS Officer/Sr. MELS Officer in executing project-level MEL tasks, ensuring alignment with organizational standards.
* Ensure effective rollout and management of Project Management Information System (PMIS).
* Standardize MEL tools, SOPs, quality assurance protocols, and reporting templates across all projects.
* Coordinate quarterly and annual data reviews, ensuring data integrity and consistency across all programs.
* Support digital transformation initiatives in MEL—including automation, dashboards, Power BI, and AI-enabled quality checks.
* Ensure integration of standard indicators, harmonized PIRS definitions, and alignment with Heifer’s MELS standards.

**Project Level MEL Execution and Quality Assurance (30%)**

* Lead implementation of baselines, midline, endline surveys, outcome monitoring, and special studies across projects.
* Prepare and review ToRs for external evaluators; supervise consultants and research partners.
* Review data sets, conduct data cleaning, and ensure analysis is accurate and ready for reporting.
* Oversee routine Data Quality Assessments (DQAs) at partner and field levels.
* Ensure real-time tracking of log-frame and IPTT indicator progress for all projects.
* Support adaptive management through technical advisories and evidence-based recommendations.

**Data Analytics, Reporting, and Knowledge Management (15%)**

* Lead consolidation and analysis of program data for monthly, quarterly, and donor reporting.
* Lead data validation, triangulation, and synthesis before reports are shared with external stakeholders.
* Develop dashboards, analytical briefs, and presentations for leadership and stakeholders.
* Develop periodic program performance briefs for decision-making.
* Support the Associate Director in generating evidence for proposal development, resource mobilization, and program design.
* Document and disseminate learning products, case studies, and program insights.
* Organize learning events and cross-project knowledge exchange sessions.
* Capacity Building (15%)
* Provide direct supervision, mentoring, and performance oversight to the MELS Officer/Sr. MELS Officer to ensure consistent quality of MEL implementation across projects.
* Build capacities of program teams, partner NGOs, enumerators, and field staff on MEL tools, data systems, and analytical methods.
* Support onboarding of new project staff on MELS guidelines, systems, and digital tools.
* Lead training on SurveyCTO, data quality protocols, ODK, dashboards, and evaluation methodologies.
* Support the Associate Director in building a culture of evidence-driven decision-making within the program team.

**Sub Award Design, Program Quality, and Donor Compliance (5%)**

* Support development of MEL budgets, theory of change, logical framework, PIRS, and evaluation frameworks for new proposals.
* Contribute to donor reporting, especially sections related to outputs, outcomes, and impact.
* Track sub-award performance (physical and financial) and provide MEL-related guidance to sub-awardees.

**May perform other job-related duties as requested (5%)**
**Qualifications And Experience**

* Master’s degree in development studies, Economics, Statistics, Agriculture, Public Policy, Management, or other relevant fields.
* Advanced training in MEL, research methods, or data analytics is preferred.
* A minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in Monitoring, Evaluation, Learning, and Systems (MELS) within INGOs/development sector.
* At least 3–4 years leading MEL functions at project or portfolio level, including evaluation design, sampling, data management, and analysis.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience managing and supervising a team, preferably MELS staff.
* Demonstrated experience managing or quality assuring baselines, midlines, endlines, and outcome monitoring.
* Strong experience in digital MEL systems, including ODK/SurveyCTO, PMIS, and data visualisation platforms.
* Proven ability to validate, analyze, and synthesize complex data for decision-making.
* Experience developing MEL components for proposals (log frames, ToC, indicators, PIRS, MEL budgets, evaluation costing).
* Experience coordinating with external evaluators, research agencies, and managing evaluation contracts.
* Familiarity with agriculture/livestock development programs is an advantage.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong analytical skills with experience in quantitative and qualitative methods.
* Proficiency in at least one statistical or analytical software (SPSS, STATA, R, or equivalent).
* Advanced Excel and Power BI skills for dashboards and performance tracking.
* Strong understanding of MEL planning, logframe/results framework, IPTT, and data quality standards.
* Ability to interpret data and generate actionable insights aligned with program strategies.
* Ability to lead technical teams and coordinate MEL execution across multiple projects.

**Behavioral & Managerial Competencies**

* Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and deliver within deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to supervise, coach, and build capacity of team members, ensuring high-quality MEL execution.
* High level of integrity, professionalism, and meticulous attention to data quality.
* Ability to work effectively with diverse cultures and stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to translate evidence into program improvements.
* Commitment to continuous learning and innovation in MEL.

title: Founder's Office Intern

title: Copy of Production Support Engineer
description:
We are hiring in Noida, India & Montreal, Canada
  
  
**About Ampliwork, Inc**
Ampliwork builds Enterprise-Grade AI Agents that amplify Human Potential™ to drive
  
  
business productivity and growth since 2017. Ampliwork’s AI Agents streamline complex
  
  
multi-step workflows in highly regulated industries such as Financial Services.
  
  
Ampliwork builds and runs AI platforms for enterprise clients. Those platforms are in production, and the people using them need a reliable place to take questions, issues and requests. This is a new role, and it owns that first line of response.
  
  
You take everything that arrives from client users, resolve what can be resolved, investigate what needs investigating, and pass to engineering only the items that genuinely require an engineer, complete and reproduced. Most of what comes in should be closed by you.
  
  
The role covers several client deployments. Volumes vary by account and by week, so holding multiple contexts at once and prioritising sensibly across them is a central part of the job. Response and resolution targets are agreed with each client and vary by severity. We will walk through how that works at interview.
  
  
**What You Will Own**
****First response and first-line resolution****

* Own the support queue end to end: acknowledge new requests promptly, classify them by severity, and drive every item to resolution or to a complete handoff.
* Answer usage and configuration questions directly, from the documentation and your own understanding of the product. A large share of inbound volume is not a defect: there are questions, workflow misunderstandings, enhancement ideas, and reports that turn out to be working as designed. Resolving those yourself is one of the main contributions of the role.
* Where the system behaviour is expected, walk the user through the correct workflow and close the loop with them. Where it is a defect, confirm that properly before escalating.
* Go back to the requester for whatever is missing, including screenshots, record references, steps to reproduce, timestamps and environment detail.

Technical investigation and triage
  
  

* Carry out first-level technical triage: inspect application and cloud logs, run read-only database queries, reproduce the reported behaviour, and form your own view of the likely cause.
* Read application code well enough to locate the relevant logic and confirm or rule out a hypothesis.
* Work each ticket from more than one angle before drawing a conclusion, and recognise when you have reached the limit of what you can resolve on your own.
* Treat our internal AI triage tooling as a starting point rather than an answer. Check its classification and its suggested cause, correct it where it is wrong, and add your own findings.

**Escalation And Follow-through**

* Escalate only the tickets that need it, with a reproducible case, logs, affected records, environment detail and your own analysis attached.
* Create and own the tasks sent downstream to the engineering team, then follow them through fix, review and release, and verify in production.
* Push back where a request sits outside agreed scope, and route it as an enhancement rather than letting it enter the queue as a defect.
* Judge when to ask for help. Flagging early is preferred to spending a day stuck on the same problem.

**Client Communication**

* Act as the named point of contact for client users, over email, the support portal and chat. You will be writing to experienced enterprise users, in some cases daily.
* Keep them informed at an agreed cadence, including regular status updates on high-severity issues until they are resolved, whether or not there is progress to report.
* Tell clients plainly what is known, what is being done, and when they will next hear from you. Tickets should not go quiet.
* Hold your position courteously when a request is out of scope or a severity label is wrong, and know when to bring colleagues into the conversation.

**Knowledge, Reporting And Improvement**

* Contribute to the knowledge base as you go, covering known issues, workarounds, runbooks and standard responses, so that a repeat occurrence takes less work than the first. The work you do here will contribute directly to the skills of the triage AI Agent.
* Produce a weekly support report for each account, covering volume, mix, response performance, ageing, open high-severity items and the recurring issues that warrant a permanent fix.
* Surface effort being spent outside agreed scope so that it can be reviewed.
* Give feedback on the triage tooling. Where its classification or draft replies are wrong, explain why, so that it can be improved rather than worked around.

**Essential**
****What we are looking for****

* Three to five years in application support, production support, technical support engineering, or a comparable client-facing technical role.
* Python. Able to read and debug application code, and write small scripts to inspect data or verify behaviour.
* Cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent). Comfortable navigating logs and monitoring to trace an issue through a running system.
* SQL and PostgreSQL. Able to write your own queries to answer data-level questions without waiting for someone else.
* A track record of resolving tickets rather than routing them. At interview we will ask you to talk through issues you closed yourself that others might have escalated.
* Excellent written English. Most of your output is writing, and much of it goes directly to a client. You will also regularly be on calls with client users, being able to explain how the system works using vocabulary that is relevant to client, is important.
* Self-starting and methodical. You take notes, follow up on open items without being prompted, and keep track of everything that is outstanding.
* Comfortable being assertive. The role involves challenging a severity label, declining an out-of-scope request, and telling a client that what they are describing is not a defect.
* Able to carry several accounts and unrelated products at the same time, and to switch between them without losing track.
* Able to learn a complex domain application quickly. Our platforms carry substantial business logic, and supporting them well means understanding that logic rather than recognising screens.
* Comfortable being accountable for response times and for the client relationship, not only for ticket counts.

****Desirable****

* Experience working to defined service levels in enterprise, regulated or audited environments.
* Experience with an enterprise ticketing platform and a downstream engineering task tracker.
* Additional languages.
* Exposure to financial services, professional services, insurance, tax or transport operations.
* Experience working alongside AI agents or automation within a support workflow.

**How Success Is Measured**
****Horizon****
**What Good Looks Like**
First 30 days
  
  
You own the queue on your first account, acknowledge new requests within the agreed window, and classify severity correctly without help. Requests waiting on missing information are chased and moving.
  
  
60 days
  
  
Only the tickets that need an engineer reach engineering, and they arrive complete and reproduced. The weekly support report is running as a standing item, and the knowledge base covers the issues that recur.
  
  
90 days

Enterprise ticketing and task tracking, Microsoft 365, AWS (logs, monitoring and managed databases), PostgreSQL, Python, Git, and our internal AI triage tooling.

title: Senior Consultant - GIS
description:
**Job Description**
WSP is seeking an experienced GIS Consultant to join our multidisciplinary team supporting the US Earth & Environment (E&E) Business Line. The GIS consultant will provide advanced expertise in geospatial analyses, environmental data management, and cartographic support for projects related to site investigation and remediation, power generation and distribution, environmental impact assessments, environmental planning and permitting, and other similar areas.
  
  
The team you will join offers an exciting diversity of projects and clients. You will lead delivery and ensure technical excellence across all phases of the project. The role will be based in either Bengaluru or Noida.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Effectively execute GIS workflows for power & energy and environmental projects, from data acquisition, digitizing, processing, analyses, QA/QC and final cartographic delivery, with minimal supervision
* Design, manage, and maintain scalable project geodatabases, including schema development, metadata standards, and long-term data stewardship.
* Produce defensible GIS analyses and presentation-quality cartographic products (maps, drawings, figures, charts, posters, etc.) for diverse audience including clients, regulators, engineers, and non-technical stakeholders.
* Conduct constraint, sensitivity, and impact analyses for routing and siting studies, translating complex environmental data into decision ready outputs.
* Lead development of map design, scale, symbology, and data limitations to prevent misinterpretation or misuse of GIS outputs.
* Implement mobile GIS and field data collection workflows, including data validation, post-processing, and enterprise integration.
* Configure and maintain ESRI web mapping environments (e.g., ArcGIS Online and/or enterprise portal) to support project teams, including publishing layers, organizing web maps, and controlling permissions/roles.
* Maintain high standards of data quality management, including QA/QC procedures, error detection, and documentation of assumptions and limitations.
* Manage multiple concurrent assignments while meeting consulting budgets, schedules, and quality expectations.

description:
**Job Description Summary**
We are hiring a FACTS Application Engineer (STATCOM/SVC) to lead technical proposal and engineering coordination activities for international FACTS projects during the tendering phase through handover to execution.
  
  
The role requires strong technical and project engineering experience, cross-functional coordination skills, and the ability to manage multidisciplinary stakeholders, customers, and subcontractors in a global environment. This is an excellent opportunity for an electrical/power engineering professional to contribute to advanced grid solutions within GE Vernova’s FACTS business.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Summary/Purpose:**
Are you a professional with technical background - and eager to work in a role where you can make a big difference with your contribution? Join us now, as an Application Engineering Manager (AE) for FACTS project.
  
  
Within GE Vernova and Grid Solutions, the FACTS Solution Line (SL) is fully accountable for costing (ITO : Inquiry-To-Order) and providing (OTR : Order-To-Remittance) integrated FACTS solutions worldwide. As such, it owns its tendering force, operations, R&D and product management. It benefits from a complete portfolio of solutions/products to propose electrical reactive power compensations options to Grid Operators, TSOs, Developers…
  
  
GE FACTS portfolio is the most complete of the marketplace and it is composed of FSC, Synchronous Condensers, SVC and STATCOM. For which GE holds either a market / product leadership positions or a main contender position.
  
  
An overall growth plan has been elaborated focusing on either technical leapfrogs or market exploration/acquisitions to reach our growth objectives. To support it, our commercial intensity in the Power Electronics area (STATCOM/SVC) is of paramount importance, we are hiring an
**Application Engineer**
to lead our technical proposal.
  
  
**Essential Responsibilities**
In this position, you will be responsible of leading and overseeing engineering activities of the international FACTS projects from tendering stage to handover to project execution organization. You’ll have the overall responsibility of the engineering coordination activities of the named project(s) in close cooperation with the Bid Manager, engineering team, and sub-contractors. The AE role includes also coordination and co-operation of the other multicultural GE units participating to the project over the globe.
  
  
**Your Duties Would Comprise Of**

* Management of overall design activities in ITO phase, defining the design quality plan, supervising and coordinating all engineering tasks required to execute the project, whether in house or by suppliers/subcontractors, and ensure technical coordination of the project in ITO phase
* Management of project engineering deliverables in accordance to the given budget and delivery time of the offer.
* Integrating internal- and external stakeholders, incl. customers, towards the common goal
* Scope management and securing that the various interfaces are seamless, no gaps or duplicates
* Guiding customers to right direction and securing GE Competitive Advantage
* Internal and external communication and reporting
* Participation to continuous development of project engineering management procedures, methods and tools

**Requirements**
To succeed in this job, you should have a degree in Engineering (Automation and Electrical Engineering or Power Electronics) and/or equivalent knowledge and experience from:

title: Consultant - Project Controls
description:
**Job Description**
WSP India is seeking to onboard dynamic and versatile Project management Expert with comprehensive experience across Document Control, Project Control, Scheduling, and Procurement to support our growing portfolio of complex engineering projects in Earth and Environment team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Document Control:**

* Oversee creation, organization, and maintenance of project documentation; ensure accuracy, accessibility, and compliance with WSP’s internal audit and quality assurance procedures.
* Work closely with departments, regional leads, and subject matter experts to gather information, manage document workflows, and ensure timely delivery and distribution of project documents.
* Create, edit, and review technical documents, manuals, reports, and drawings; maintain registers and schedules for incoming/ outgoing information.
* Manage physical and digital document storage systems; upload documents to EDMS; monitor and improve documentation workflows and processes.
* Conduct regular audits, check document quality, and ensure compliance with regulatory standards and project procedures.
* Be in continuous touch with the PM to be on top of any internal or external documentation.

**Project Cost Control:**

* Ensure alignment with client expectations and deadlines while coordinating with billing, finance, and project teams to manage accounts receivable, timesheets, expenses, and invoice-related queries.
* Prepare billing drafts, compile and verify monthly invoices, and ensure accurate manual data entry and mapping to final invoice sheets.
* Manage project setup, budgeting, task assignments, and closeout activities in Oracle Horizon, including maintaining WBS, time transfers, and compliance checks.
* Able to create Opportunity in Oracle based Horizon during proposal/ pre-proposal and update status based on directions from PM.
* Ensure necessary Risk Assessment procedures are followed while creating the opportunity in Horizon as well as help in preparing RMIS document.
* Support financial analysis and reporting by using financial systems [excel based Project Cost (PC) Control/ Financial Analysis Report (FAR) tools] to track project performance metrics, generate monthly accruals, and assess impacts of scope changes and forecast deviations.
* Collaborate with design teams to collect engineering progress data for Earned Value (EV) analysis and maintain accurate tracking of planned value, actual cost, and schedule.
* Act as liaison between GCC India and US teams for project setup, billing, and timesheet coding, while supporting the E&E PMO team in portfolio monitoring.
* Conduct data integrity checks, audits, and maintain project documentation including lessons-learned databases and meeting records.
* Should have extensive knowledge of working with ERP for project creation and maintenance.
* Should be able to create and track change order and identify, quantify and mitigate risk acting as a buddy to the PM.

**Project Scheduling:**

* Create, update, and maintain resource- and cost-loaded project schedules using Microsoft Project (MSP) or Primavera P6, based on stakeholder input, proposals, and scope documents.
* Develop activity lists, identify critical paths, and notify teams of key activities and schedule risks.
* Monitor project progress, detect deviations, and support recovery planning and schedule forecasting.
* Assess and report impacts of changes to baseline schedules and milestones, ensuring timely updates and resolution tracking.
* Support bids and proposals by preparing preliminary schedules and timelines.
* Use Earned Value Management (EVM) and financial systems to analyze and report project performance and KPIs.
* Maintain accurate Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) and integrate project schedules under an Enterprise Project Structure (EPS).

**Other Responsibilities**
:
  
  

* Draft and prepare supplier and subcontractor contracts in alignment with prime contract requirements, ensuring all necessary terms are accurately flowed down; support the US team in contract finalization and negotiation.
* Track contract performance, manage renewals and extensions, and maintain organized contract documentation and repository.
* Creation and renewal of Work Orders (WOs) and timely vendor invoice updates in Oracle Horizon ERP.
* Collaborate with Project Managers, and Finance to monitor project expenses, resolve contract-related queries, and ensure compliance with internal procurement policies and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate procurement requests from project teams, provide operational support, and assist in internal procurement audits and training.
* Utilize analytics and forecasting tools to support procurement planning, maintain accurate procurement records in Oracle, and contribute to continuous improvement through industry best practices.

**Key Competencies / Skills:**

* Proficient in MS Office Suite, especially Advanced Excel; experience with Oracle ERP (Horizon/NetSuite), Power BI is a plus.
* Skilled in project scheduling tools like Primavera P6, Microsoft Project (MSP), and SmartSheets.
* Familiar with documentation control platforms such as Aconex, Autodesk, ProjectWise.
* Strong understanding of Earned Value Management (EVM) and financial systems related to project control.
* Combined minimum 4 years of experience in project scheduling, cost control, documentation, and procurement.
* Experience supporting procurement functions, including vendor coordination and invoice tracking.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills with attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Excellent planning, organizational, and time management abilities; capable of handling multiple priorities and tight deadlines.
* Skilled in forecasting, reporting, and maintaining accurate project records and WBS structures.
* Strong coordination and problem-solving abilities; able to work independently and in teams. Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Proven ability to build and maintain relationships with internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and open to new challenges.
* Adopts a “Best for WSP” approach in daily activities.
* Flexible with work timings to support US-based project teams across time zones.

**Qualifications**

* Engineering degree with project management experience or master’s degree in construction management or project management is preferred.
* Minimum of 4 to Maximum 8 years of experience project management with Engineering / professional services consultants.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* CAPM-PMI / PMP certifications would be an added advantage.

 The Computer Science and Mathematics Specialist will design and drive advanced, future\-ready curricula that integrate Mathematics, Science, Computational Thinking, Artificial Intelligence, and Generative AI across grade levels. **Innovation, Research \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Research and benchmark global trends in AI education, STEM pedagogy, and school\-level technology adoption.

**Collaboration \& Institutional Engagement**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Science, Education, AI, or related fields.

description:
The
 **International Forum for Environment, Sustainability \& Technology (iFOREST)** 
 , is looking for an experienced and dynamic professional to support \& lead the organisation’s research initiatives and policy engagement in the Industrial transition and decarbonization.
 



  





 A successful applicant must have a proven aptitude for analytical research and multi\-stakeholder engagement, and excellent communication skills with government, industry and related agencies. The candidate should ideally have sound
 **technical and policy knowledge and experience of emerging industrial transition domains such as Green Hydrogen, Green Ammonia and Green Urea, Carbon Capture, Utilisation and Storage. Overall knowledge of industrial decarbonization is desirable.** 




  





**Location** 
 : Sector 132, Noida, India
 



  





**Required Experience** 
 : 5\+ years
 



  





**About iFOREST** 




 iFOREST is an independent not\-for\-profit research and innovation organisation that was established in 2019 to identify, promote and scale up solutions for pressing environment\-development challenges in India and other developing countries in Asia and Africa.
 



 Our work is rooted in regional priorities to accelerate environmental actions at the sub\-national level and to improve national policies and plans to support it. Our mission is to address the unique needs of regions by leveraging our resources and expertise to scale up national action and make a global impact. We use our regional knowledge to inform national policy and plans and strengthen international collaboration.
 



 To achieve our goals, we conduct independent evidence\-based research, develop new knowledge and innovative solutions, convene stakeholders to increase awareness and build consensus, and partner with think tanks, civil society, government agencies, philanthropies and industry to scale up solutions.
 



  





**The Industrial Decarbonization Programmme** 




 The Industrial Decarbonization Programme is a part of iFOREST’s flagship initiative on Enabling Energy Transitions. The objective of the programme is to steer a green industry transition to support green growth and green jobs, while improving local environmental conditions and achieving climate goals. The focus is on conducing evidence\-based research, including modelling studies to develop comprehensive roadmaps, identify policy solutions and provide technical support for industrial decarbonisation in sectors like Chemicals and fertilizer particularly\- Green Hydrogen, Green Ammonia, green Urea etc.
 



 The Programme is strongly focused on technical research and stakeholder engagement (especially with government departments/agencies and the industry) to achieve a green transition of fossil fuel\-dependent factories that are associated with various industries.
 



  





**The Role** 




 The Programme Associate will be responsible for the execution of research and engagement outputs pertaining to industrial decarbonisation across boiler based industries and MSME sector. This would entail conducting impactful research and multi\-stakeholder engagement, with the support of a dedicated team. In addition, they would also be expected to identify new areas of work to support institutional goals.

* Conduct in\-depth primary and secondary research including quantitative and qualitative assessments.
* Remain updated with the latest tools and techniques for executing qualitative and quantitative research.

* Mentor young researchers in in the team in executing research assignments.
* Stay abreast with the latest developments and debates in the sector.



**Lead the outreach and communication**

**Additional duties**

 **Master’s in engineering is a must, preferably in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Chemical, Power System, and Environmental or related streams.**

 **Energy and GHG, Green Hydrogen, Green Ammonia, Renewable Energy, and relevant green technologies and decarbonisation levers.**

title: Technical Editor
description:
**Reporting to \- Head of Publishing Operations** 




  





**About Packt** 




 Packt's mission is to help the world put software to work in new ways, through the delivery of effective learning and information services to IT professionals. We are a technical publisher and learning provider with over 400 staff based across the globe, primarily in India and the UK. Our products have global relevance, and our multimedia portfolio includes over 7,000 books, e\-books, audiobooks, and video courses.
 



 For more details, visit www.packtpub.com.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 As a technical editor, you will work in partnership with content creators and editors to create high\-quality products on time, according to the publishing plan. You own the product’s technical accuracy, working with the content creator and other internal stakeholders from the delivery of the first draft of the content to publication. The TE is an editorial quality\-control role. The goal of editorial is to raise the revenue performance of every product by understanding content creator and user needs and the market we're publishing into.
 



 The role is ideal for methodical thinkers who can carry out efficient and purposeful code testing, using excellent technical skills. You will adopt an advisory role with content creators, using firm and diplomatic communication to help them understand the technical concerns that you have. This will lead to accurate technical content that allows readers to easily learn about new technologies and develop new skills.
 



 The TE will, in addition to the above, work on different product types to ensure they all meet the standards expected by our customers. These product types may be derived products, such as an audiobook or course based on a book. They may be new products created through market and user research.
 



 This demands a strong focus on quality from TEs: you will understand the level of quality our customers expect and own this on your products. To do this you will have to seek customer feedback throughout the editorial process and apply this during your testing. It is vital you keep track of new tech releases and user trends.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




**Technical:** 



* Ensure technical accuracy of the content: test all code in the product, as well as all code in the code bundle, ensuring they match
* Follow along with all examples and steps in the product
* Address any other technical concerns you find in the book (technical facts, references, screenshots, architecture, approach, and so on)
* Ensure code indentation is accurate and that the code remains consistent throughout the content
* Verify content coverage thoroughly to ensure technical accuracy
* Perform quality checks on code\-related Amazon reviews, errata, and GitHub issues
* Manage book repositories on GitHub and resolve any reader queries alongside the customer care team
* Support the team to improve code repositories and code\-testing systems
* Research technology innovations to deepen your tech. knowledge in your vertical’s topic area
* Connect to users and research to deepen your knowledge of users in your vertical’s topic area
* Keep up with market changes that could impact the delivery or success of a product, for example, tech. version updates and competing titles



  





**Editorial:** 



* Function as a reader advocate for your book from a technical point of view
* Query the author if any part of the code isn’t clear
* Provide a technical health check for the portfolio director to facilitate accurate planning and time allocation
* Carry out user research and market analysis to elevate your work
* Work with technical reviewers to ensure technical accuracy of the content and code. Use this to build up an understanding of the book and its audience
* Own the technical quality of a product: sign off the technical aspects of a product for production; advise on whether a product is suitable for cancellation
* Navigate the optimum balance of quality and timeliness in dialog with the rest of the product team
* Apply the Packt styles to the content and ensure the formatting follows the Packt style sheet



**Author/Expert management:** 



* Provide detailed and constructive feedback to content creators using the appropriate tone to suggest the necessary actions that will ensure that the technical content matches the proposition and meets Packt’s quality standards
* Build positive yet challenging relationships to get the most from content creators



  





**Who You Are** 




 You are a logical, efficient technical editor with a strong passion for creating high\-quality, technical content. You possess a good understanding of technology and are skilled at code testing. You work collaboratively with authors, editors, and technical reviewers, balancing high standards with commercial and product goals. You thrive in dynamic environments and continuously seek to optimize processes and workflows to deliver exceptional content.
 



  





**Must\-have skills:** 



* Technology testing: good working knowledge of at least one technology to the level that you can test code and examples in that domain area
* Quality assurance: rigorous attention to detail with a proven track record of ensuring content quality, accuracy, and consistency
* Technical content understanding: strong ability to interpret and convey complex technical concepts clearly for diverse audiences
* Research: the ability to get up to speed on an unfamiliar technology so you can test and evaluate technical content in that topic
* Author relationship management: the ability to build relationships with authors, providing constructive feedback and ensuring their vision is realized
* Stakeholder communication: good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with cross\-functional teams and senior stakeholders



  





**Good\-to\-have skills:** 



* Process optimization: ability to identify inefficiencies and suggest improvements in quality\-control processes and workflows
* Adaptability: ability to adapt quickly to changing requirements and navigate ambiguity in fast\-paced environments



  





**Why Work at Packt** 




 We are a global and remote\-first business with most of our team based in India and the UK. We recognize how important our people are and acknowledge and support the things that are important to them. Our culture is open and informal and based around learning. We love sharing ideas and we want everyone to feel that they have an input into how the business works. We are a fun place to work but with a focus on performance and personal development providing opportunities for personal growth and career progression. We try to achieve this by:
 


* Ensuring a positive working environment for all team members, supportive of flexible and remote work.
* Supporting individual development through growth opportunities and internal mobility.
* Encouraging social collaboration within teams and communities and knowledge\-sharing.
* Fostering a culture that supports a healthy work\-life balance.



 We focus on the full employee experience. We seek to achieve this by:
 


* Providing a broad range of benefits and initiatives.
* Advocating a healthy lifestyle where wellbeing is seen as an essential responsibility.
* Celebrating success stories and encouraging peer\-to\-peer recognition.
* Fostering a culture of self\-development.
* Providing a work environment where the best idea wins, and challenges are encouraged.



  





**Benefits:** 




 You will also have access to a range of flexible benefits that are designed to help you make the most of your time with us.
 



 Bonus scheme
 



 5 day working week
 



 25 days annual holiday (plus bank holidays)
 



 Flexible hours: choose how, when, and where you work within India
 



 Training programs and Certification
 



 Group Medical Insurance
 



 Wellness initiatives
 



  





**Salary Range \- INR 25 \- 60K fixed pay per month (skills and/or experience dependent)** 




  





**Disclaimer: Packt does not authorize any third\-party consultancies, influencers, or agencies to offer employment opportunities on our behalf. We are not involved in any financial transactions with these parties. Our hiring process is managed internally, and all applications should be made through the official procedures outlined in our job listings.**

**Role Overview** 
 :
 



 We are seeking an experienced and detail\-oriented Manager – Project Management, Planning, Documentation \& Engineering to oversee key aspects of civil engineering, architectural planning, site execution, MEP and design coordination across large\-scale warehouse, infrastructure, EPC, commercial, and fitout projects. The ideal candidate will possess over 14 years of robust experience in the construction industry, including significant expertise in underground metro rail systems, cargo terminals, high\-rise buildings, and site development.
 



 This role bridges the gap between detailed engineering design, material procurement, contractor/vendor management, and site execution to ensure project deliverables meet stringent cost, quality, and time metrics.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 
 :
 



**1\. Project Planning, Scheduling \& Monitoring** 



* Develop and track work completion schedules, resource requirement plans, and progress milestones to ensure timely project delivery and client handover.
* Prepare/Review project layouts, site survey plans, site level plans, and execution schedules aligned with technical drawings.
* Monitor site activity, conduct weekly progress and design review meetings, and eliminate site bottlenecks.



**2\. Engineering Design \& Coordination** 



* Review project contracts, scopes of work, architectural inputs, tender documents, and specifications.
* Act as a primary technical liaison between internal stakeholders, Detail Design Consultants (DDC), contractors, system\-wise contractors, and internal execution teams.
* Manage design inception, submission drawings, shop drawings, working drawings, and as\-built drawing and checklists records.
* Prepare and review Design Basis Requirements (DBR) and Method Statements for architectural/civil scope items.



**3\. Commercials, Billing \& Estimation** 



* Prepare detailed Bills of Quantities (BOQ) for tender floating, material finalizations, bill verification and certification and issuing COP etc.
* Oversee contractor and client billing processes, vendor invoice approvals, and cross\-check material reconciliation against store records.
* Review and analyze estimation costs, material requirements, and supply procurement schedules.



**4\. Site Execution, Material Selection \& Quality Assurance** 



* Direct site operations for civil works, Piling works, Pre\-Engineered Buildings (PEB), RCC framed structures, block work, plastering, waterproofing, and high\-end finishing (e.g., granite/Kota flooring, false ceilings, SS/glass cladding).
* Lead material selection and finalize finishing materials in coordination with internal stakeholders; verify material quality during site arrival.
* Ensure strict adherence to quality checks across civil, architectural, and MEP integration works.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 
 :
 


* Bachelor’s Degree (B.Tech / B.E.): Civil Engineering (or AMIE certification equivalent) with a strong academic record.
* Diploma / Certification: Diploma in Architectural Assistantship or relevant drafting/architectural qualifications.
* Experience: Minimum 12–15 years of progressive experience in construction management, with at least 8 years in warehouse/ office fitouts/cargo or major infra projects.



 Software \& Technical Proficiency:
 


* CAD Tools: Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD (2024/2026\) for drawing generation, review, and modifications.
* Office Applications: Advanced knowledge of MS Excel, MS Word, and MS PowerPoint for reporting, cost estimation, and presentations.
* Core Competencies: BOQ Preparation, Site Surveys, Method Statements, Quality Assurance, Material Reconciliation, Procurement, and Contractor Billing.



  





**Personal \& Behavioural Characteristics:** 



* Strong cross\-functional team management and site team coordination skills.
* Excellent communication skills for managing client relations, consultants, and contractors.
* Analytical problem\-solving ability to address design conflicts and site constraints.

 About the Role
 



 We are hiring a Content \& Communications Intern for the Content team. This is an experienced\-track internship: we expect prior writing experience, and the role is designed to build toward a full\-time content career at E\-Solutions.
 



 You will work directly with the Content Manager across technology, AI, workforce solutions, digital transformation, global hiring, employer branding and corporate communications. The requirement is not simply grammatically correct writing. We need someone who can absorb a brief, identify the real message, research intelligently, question weak wording and communicate with clarity and maturity.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* **Exceptional English.** 
 Outstanding command of grammar, vocabulary, sentence construction, tone and professional business communication, written and spoken.
* **Strong comprehension.** 
 You understand detailed briefs, conversations, source material and business requirements accurately, first time, without repeated explanation.
* **Intellectual curiosity and rigor.** 
 You want to understand the "why" behind a product, service, technology or business problem before you write about it.
* **Editorial judgment.** 
 You can tell the difference between generic marketing language and specific, credible, useful communication, and you can explain why a piece of copy works or does not.
* **Comfort with technology subjects.** 
 IT, AI, SaaS, digital transformation, staffing and workforce solutions should interest you, not intimidate you.
* **Independent research ability.** 
 You can research a topic, validate what you find and synthesize multiple sources into something coherent.
* **Meticulous editing.** 
 Grammar, punctuation, terminology, structure, consistency and factual accuracy all get your attention before you submit.
* **Professional maturity.** 
 Responsive, accountable, receptive to feedback, and able to hold ownership of your work while collaborating across teams.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Research and write content across E\-Solutions’ technology, workforce and corporate brands.
* Develop website copy, landing pages, blogs, articles, thought leadership, LinkedIn posts, email and campaign copy, and internal communications.
* Translate complex IT, AI and business concepts into clear, engaging content for B2B audiences and senior stakeholders.
* Support content calendars, campaigns, content series and messaging frameworks.
* Review and refine existing content for clarity, grammar, tone, structure, accuracy and brand alignment.
* Research technology trends, competitors, industries and audience pain points to strengthen the work.
* Support SEO\-focused content, including keyword integration, search intent, headings, metadata and internal linking.
* Maintain consistency in brand voice, terminology, positioning and messaging across every asset.



  





**Experience \& Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Marketing, Communications, Business or a related discipline.
* 2\-3 years of content\-writing experience, including professional, agency, freelance or extended internship work.
* Experience writing for IT, technology, SaaS, digital transformation, staffing, workforce solutions or B2B services is highly preferred.
* A writing portfolio is required. Technology, B2B, website, thought\-leadership, LinkedIn or long\-form samples carry the most weight.
* A working understanding of SEO and digital marketing is an advantage.



  





**The Standard We Work To** 




 This is a quality\-first content function. The people who do well here share a simple working method:
 


* Read before writing. Understand before explaining. Research before claiming.
* Structure the idea before filling the page and edit before submitting.
* Use AI as research and drafting aid, never as a substitute for understanding, verification or original thinking.



 If you can take a business objective and build strong content from it, rather than needing each sentence translated into instructions, you will enjoy this role and grow quickly in it.
 



 Applications without writing samples will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a short writing and editing exercise assessing English proficiency, comprehension, research ability, structure and content judgment.
 



  





**What You Will Gain** 



* Hands\-on exposure to enterprise B2B marketing and communications.
* Experience across IT, AI, workforce solutions and digital transformation.
* Practical grounding in content strategy, SEO, social media, website content and demand\-generation content.
* Direct editorial guidance from the Content Manager within a professional content function.
* A portfolio of technology and business content you can stand behind.



*E\-Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and select solely on merit and capability.*

 E\-Solutions \| B\-4/5, B Block, Sector 63, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201301

description:

**Role Overview**
 STMicroelectronics is seeking a highly organized and proactive Data Governance \& Quality Lead to drive enterprise\-wide data quality, governance, and process documentation initiatives across People Function.
   

  

 This role will be responsible for establishing and maintaining data governance frameworks, standardizing master and transactional data across regions and systems, defining data ownership and maintenance policies, and implementing robust data quality controls. In parallel, the role will ensure that global policies, procedures, and standard operating processes (SOPs) remain accurate, current, and aligned with evolving business requirements.
   

  

 The successful candidate will combine strong project management capabilities with process excellence, stakeholder management, and data governance expertise to enable operational efficiency, compliance, and future\-ready self\-service capabilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Process Documentation \& Knowledge Governance
* Develop and maintain data dictionaries, business rules, and data standards.
* Define data creation, modification, approval, and maintenance processes.
* Implement data quality monitoring mechanisms, KPIs, dashboards, and periodic audits.

* Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI, and knowledge management technologies to improve user experience and operational effectiveness.
* Support the transformation toward self\-service and intelligent support models.
* Project \& Stakeholder Management
* Lead cross\-functional governance and process improvement initiatives.
* Develop project plans, governance forums, milestones, and implementation roadmaps.
* Facilitate alignment among global stakeholders, regional teams, business owners, and IT organizations.
* Track progress, risks, dependencies, and outcomes across multiple initiatives.
* Provide regular reporting and executive\-level updates on governance maturity, data quality, and documentation health.


**Required Qualifications**

* Proven experience managing cross\-functional projects in global organizations.

* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

**Success Measures**

 At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Staff / Senior Staff – AI\-Enabled Technology Advisory**
**India**
**Role Overview**
 Crowe’s Technology Advisory practice is seeking a hands\-on AI\-enabled technology advisory professional to join our India\-based team and support U.S.\-based consulting teams.
   

  

 This role is designed for someone who actively works in AI tools throughout the day and enjoys building, testing, refining, and documenting better ways of working. The successful candidate will combine strong analytical skills with practical AI fluency to support client engagements and build reusable workflows for research, file analysis, synthesis, writing, presentation development, and knowledge management.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be comfortable working across tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Notion, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and Power Platform. They should be able to write and refine prompts and Claude skills, compare alternative approaches, test output quality, and improve workflows until they produce reliable, professional results.
   

  

 This is not a data science, machine learning, or purely technical development role. It is a hands\-on advisory and delivery role focused on improving the speed, quality, and consistency of consulting work.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Build AI\-Enabled Delivery Workflows**
* Create and maintain reusable AI workflows for research, document review, file analysis, synthesis, writing, and presentation development
* Write and refine Claude skills, system instructions, prompts, custom assistants, and workflow templates
* Build structured processes for analyzing interview notes, client files, data rooms, requirements, prior deliverables, and other source materials
* Define clear inputs, outputs, validation steps, and human\-review checkpoints
* Convert repeatable consulting activities into documented workflows
* Maintain and improve existing workflows as tools and models change


**Test and Refine AI Outputs**
* Compare AI tools, models, prompts, context approaches, and workflow designs
* Conduct structured A/B testing using defined evaluation criteria
* Evaluate outputs for accuracy, completeness, consistency, insight, and usability
* Document test results, version history, lessons learned, and recommended approaches
* Identify gaps, errors, unsupported conclusions, and weak analysis in AI\-generated content
* Continue refining solutions rather than accepting the first usable output


**Perform Analysis and Develop Deliverables**
* Review and synthesize information from documents, spreadsheets, presentations, interview notes, and other source materials
* Identify key themes, risks, findings, inconsistencies, and implications
* Support development of clear conclusions and practical recommendations
* Create well\-structured written deliverables and professional PowerPoint presentations
* Support Excel\-based analysis, cost estimates, and financial models
* Validate AI\-generated content against source materials before it is used
* Apply judgment to determine whether an output is accurate, clear, and decision\-useful


**Build Knowledge and Content Systems**
* Organize prompts, skills, workflows, templates, evaluations, and guidance in Notion or similar platforms
* Develop structured data and knowledge systems that organize source materials, findings, and reusable content
* Support content organization across Notion, SharePoint, Teams, and Microsoft 365
* Maintain clear documentation, version history, and usage instructions
* Create quick\-reference guides and supporting materials that allow others to reuse workflows


**Support Enterprise Tools and Automation**
* Explore how AI workflows can operate with SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Power Automate, Power Apps, Copilot Studio, and related tools
* Build or support simple low\-code automations and multi\-tool workflows
* Use scripting, APIs, MCP, structured data, or AI\-assisted coding where appropriate
* Help design processes for moving, reviewing, analyzing, and storing files
* Support approved content access, permissions, confidentiality, and governance requirements
* Coordinate with technical teams when advanced development or integration support is needed


**Support Consulting Engagements**
* Work with U.S.\-based and India\-based team members to understand delivery needs
* Support IT Due Diligence, IT Assessment, integration, ERP advisory, and related engagements
* Review and synthesize client data and technical materials
* Assist in building findings, recommendations, presentations, cost estimates, and other deliverables
* Independently manage defined workstreams and deliverables
* Collaborate effectively across time zones and communicate progress clearly
* Build working knowledge across areas such as enterprise applications, data and reporting, AI, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and IT operations
* Develop deeper knowledge in one or more technology domains over time


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience
* Strong hands\-on experience using generative AI tools for professional work
* Demonstrated experience building and refining prompts, reusable assistants, workflows, or automations
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem\-solving skills
* Ability to review multiple sources and synthesize information into clear findings
* Strong written communication and PowerPoint development skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and the ability to support analysis and modeling
* Ability to execute against clear direction and independently work through open\-ended problems
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
* Strong organizational, documentation, and task\-management skills
* Ability to work collaboratively across time zones
* Ability to identify unsupported conclusions or quality issues in AI\-generated content


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Advanced experience with Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Notion, or similar tools
* Experience creating Claude skills, custom GPTs, project instructions, reusable agents, or prompt libraries
* Experience conducting structured A/B testing or comparing alternative workflow approaches
* Experience with SharePoint, Teams, Microsoft 365, Power Automate, Power Apps, or Copilot Studio
* Familiarity with APIs, MCP, scripting, structured data, schema design, low\-code development, or AI\-assisted coding
* Experience with document analysis, enterprise search, or knowledge management
* Familiarity with consulting, professional services, technology advisory, ERP, due diligence, integration, or business transformation
* Working knowledge in one or more IT domains, such as enterprise systems, data and reporting, AI, cybersecurity, infrastructure, or IT operations
* Experience supporting U.S.\-based or global teams


**What Success Looks Like**
 Within the first 90 days, the successful candidate will:
   

  

* Understand the practice’s core workflows, deliverables, and quality standards
* Build and document reusable AI\-enabled workflows
* Create and refine prompts, Claude skills, or reusable AI instructions
* Conduct structured tests comparing prompts, tools, models, or workflow approaches
* Produce accurate written analysis, Excel\-based support, and professional PowerPoint output
* Organize prompts, workflows, evaluation results, and guidance in Notion or another knowledge platform
* Support an initial use case involving SharePoint, Microsoft 365, or Power Platform
* Contribute effectively to consulting workstreams and client deliverables
* Incorporate feedback from senior team members and continuously improve the solution
* Demonstrate measurable improvements in efficiency, consistency, or output quality


**Ideal Candidate Profile**
 The ideal candidate:
   

  

* Uses AI tools regularly and enjoys experimenting with them
* Likes adjusting prompts, instructions, and workflows until the output improves
* Can perform the underlying analysis rather than relying entirely on AI
* Understands the difference between polished language and meaningful insight
* Produces organized, accurate, and professional work
* Is comfortable working across documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and knowledge systems
* Enjoys building reusable solutions rather than repeating manual tasks
* Can accept feedback, improve quickly, and operate with limited direction
* Is reliable, detail\-oriented, and able to support a global consulting team
* Is curious about tools, models, integrations, and emerging capabilities


**What This Role Is Not**
 This role is not primarily focused on:
   

  

* Building machine\-learning models
* Conducting academic AI research
* Traditional software engineering
* Creating AI strategy presentations without hands\-on execution
* Writing prompts without evaluating the underlying analysis
* Producing PowerPoint slides without understanding the content
* Testing new tools without turning them into repeatable processes
