title: Assistant Consultant - Project Management
description:
**Job Description**
 WSP India is seeking a Project Coordinator to support our technically advanced and complex projects. We require an experienced Deputy Project Manager familiar with international delivery models, who can provide high\-quality project management support services. This position is available within our dynamic team located in Bengaluru, Mumbai, and Noida. At WSP, you will have opportunities to work on landmark projects with talented professionals from around the world. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 As a part of the GCC UK Air Quality team, the primary function and duties include:
   

  

* Assist Project Managers and Project Directors in fulfilling contracted project management obligations throughout the entire project lifecycle, from inception to completion including opportunity governance and pricing, budget creation and change management and working capital management making effective contributions to project management processes, regardless of project scale or complexity.
* Responsible for correctly updating project data monthly within WSP’s project management Oracle based system.
* Supporting PMs/PDs with Estimate at Completion (EAC) updates, progress reporting, and Earned Value insights
* Assist in developing, monitoring, and reporting on key performance metrics by applying tools and procedures that contribute to successful project delivery.
* Operate independently with minimal supervision by planning and prioritizing work to ensure scope of service obligations are met.
* Champion excellent health and safety practices to achieve safe, sustainable, and efficient outcomes that meet agreed objectives.
* Proactively identify and highlight threats to progress and scope of service obligations.
* Prepare monthly reports, meeting minutes, and other management documentation to support successful delivery including the monitoring and updating of project schedules and progress against milestones.
* Assist in developing project management documentation, including project management plans, cost estimates and forecasts, risk registers, project schedules, and stakeholder registers.
* Undertake information management activities via industry\-standard Common Data Environments such as SharePoint and ProjectWise.
* Work with multi\-disciplinary environmental project teams consisting of technical and professional staff and suppliers.
* Assist in the administration of supplier contracts.


 We are looking for a staff member with proven experience in all the areas indicated above and experience working within a large and geographically disbursed environment. The position offers an exciting opportunity to develop a career within a large and expanding global corporate environment
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Key Competencies
   

  

 Essential:
   

  

 Education \& Experience
   

  

* Degree in a relevant discipline (such as environment, project management, engineering, science, building or quantity surveying) or a combination of relevant project management experience and qualifications.
* Demonstrable project co\-ordination/management skills reflecting the responsibilities above including regarding cost controls, budget updates and forecasting impacts of over or under performance. with an interest in land quality.
* This role is expected to suit someone with 2\-4 years relevant post graduate experience


 Language Proficiency
   

  

* Strong spoken and written English, demonstrated by an internationally recognised English language qualification.


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Numerically competent – able to forecast impacts of changes to cost and revenue models
* Confident in obtaining information from people and proactive in approach.
* Skilled at analysing information from diverse sources and assembling it into meaningful documents (e.g., reports, programs, spreadsheets).
* Capable of managing, recording, and prioritizing business activities, with the ability to recognize and reconcile conflicts to achieve objectives.
* Responsive to change, with the ability to accurately record and communicate variations and their consequences.
* Comfortable receiving instructions, executing defined tasks, and accepting personal responsibility for actions.
* Understands the importance of supporting overseas managers to fulfil defined contractual obligations.


 Technical \& Professional Skills
   

  

* Proficient with Microsoft Project, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word – Power BI and Advanced Excel skills would be an advantage.
* Knowledgeable about industry standards and best practices in project management.
* Effective team player, able to work collaboratively in a team environment.
* Evidence of commercial and contractual awareness, with the ability to demonstrate financial acumen and analytical skills. Experience of Oracle systems would be an advantage


 Work Ethic \& Adaptability
   

  

* Routinely able to meet tight deadlines projects.
* Comfortable working independently; highly self\-motivated.
* Able to communicate effectively and efficiently across time zones both in spoken and digital formats.


 BGV:
   

  

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third\-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.


**About Us**
 WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation \& Infrastructure, Property \& Buildings, Earth \& Environment, Power \& Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.

 At “WSP” we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones:
 **Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.**

title: Community Manager – Content & Reddit
description:
**About the Role:**




 Threatcop is expanding its Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) and organic demand capture efforts, working alongside GeoZ, to improve our visibility in search and AI\-generated answers around cybersecurity, security awareness, and human risk management topics.
 



  





 We're hiring a
 **Reddit Content Writer \& Community Manager** 
 to build an authentic, helpful presence for Threatcop on Reddit. This person will research buyer questions, write genuinely useful posts and replies across relevant subreddits, and manage ongoing community engagement — always with transparent brand affiliation and respect for each community's rules and norms.
 



  





 This role sits at the intersection of content writing, community management, and organic growth strategy. It will work closely with the SEO/GEO team and subject\-matter experts to turn research and product knowledge into content that resonates on Reddit specifically.
 



  





**What You'll Do:**




**Content Writing** 



* Write clear, well\-researched, non\-promotional Reddit posts and replies on topics including cybersecurity, security awareness, social engineering, AI vishing, and deepfakes.
* Translate approved research, internal insights, and product knowledge into content formats that work on Reddit — informational posts, comparisons, AMAs, discussion threads, and thoughtful replies.
* Maintain a helpful, transparent tone that discloses brand affiliation where relevant and complies with Reddit's self\-promotion norms.



**Community Management** 



* Identify and map relevant subreddits (cybersecurity, InfoSec, IT, risk management, and adjacent communities) worth engaging in.
* Monitor ongoing discussions and buyer questions to spot content gaps and engagement opportunities.
* Manage day\-to\-day responses and engagement, building credibility and trust within each community over time.
* Learn and strictly follow each subreddit's specific rules, culture, and moderation expectations.



**Collaboration \& Reporting** 



* Work with the SEO/GEO team (including external partner GeoZ) to align content with identified buyer questions, content gaps, and GEO priorities.
* Incorporate feedback from performance results to continuously refine content and engagement approach.
* Flag emerging themes, objections, or misconceptions in the community back to the marketing/product team.



  





**What We're Looking For:**



* **1–3 years of experience** 
 in content writing, community management, or social/organic marketing (Reddit experience strongly preferred).
* Demonstrated understanding of how Reddit communities work — tone, etiquette, self\-promotion rules, and what gets downvoted vs. valued.
* Strong writing skills: able to make technical or security\-related topics clear and useful without sounding like marketing copy.
* Interest in or working knowledge of cybersecurity concepts (security awareness, social engineering, phishing/vishing, deepfakes) — or a fast learner willing to build this knowledge.
* Comfortable researching independently and synthesizing input from SMEs into original content.
* Close attention to detail and judgment around brand voice, disclosure, and community trust.
* Self\-starter who can manage ongoing engagement consistently, not just one\-off posts.



  





**Nice to Have:**



* Prior experience in B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, or IT industry content.
* Familiarity with GEO/SEO concepts and how AI\-generated answers surface content.
* Existing reputation or karma history in relevant subreddits.



  





**Success Metrics (Illustrative):**



* Growth in authentic engagement (upvotes, comments, saves) on relevant subreddits.
* Increase in brand mentions/visibility in relevant Reddit threads and AI\-generated answer citations.
* Number of buyer questions/content gaps identified and converted into content.
* Community standing (account credibility, mod relationships, no bans/flags for rule violations).



  





**Why You’ll Enjoy Working at Threatcop**



* Experience the
 **speed and ownership of a high\-growth startup** 
 with the stability of a mature, profitable organization.
* Opportunity to
 **build and lead the sales organization** 
 at a global cybersecurity product company.
* Competitive compensation with leadership\-level growth opportunities.
* Comprehensive benefits including
 **health insurance, gratuity, and Employees’ Provident Fund** 
 .
* A collaborative, merit\-driven, and inclusive workplace.



  





**About Us:**




***Threatcop Inc. is a leading People Security Management (PSM) company and a sister concern of Kratikal Tech Ltd.***




 Threatcop helps organizations reduce the impacts of cyber threats by strengthening the cybersecurity posture of employees. With a focus on reducing social engineering and email\-based attacks, we transform employees from the weakest link to the strongest line of defense.
 



  





 Serving over 250\+ large enterprises and 600\+ SMEs across 30\+ countries, Threatcop assists clients in sectors such as E\-commerce, Finance, BFSI, Healthcare, Manufacturing, and Telecom with clients like Axis Bank, Gail India, ONGC, MaxLife Insurance, Daman Insurance, UNICOIL, NPCI, Tata Consumer Products and many others. We are a USA\-based company, headquartered in Noida with offices in Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Chennai, Dubai, and Riyadh.
 



  





 We use the A\-A\-P\-E (Assess, Aware, Protect, Empower) framework to deliver effective products such as TSAT, TLMS, TDMARC and TPIR to tackle evolving cyberthreats. By focusing on preventing human error, our People Security Management (PSM) approach empowers organizations to foster a culture of cybersecurity awareness to tackle modern cyber threats.
 



 For more details, visit us at:
 

**www.threatcop.com**

description:
**Industrial Technical Visual Reasoning Specialist (Subject Matter Expert) \- Engineering** 




  





**Job Overview** 




 We are seeking experienced engineers, technical professionals, simulation specialists, and domain experts to develop high\-quality multimodal reasoning benchmarks based on authentic industrial and engineering artifacts. The experts will create realistic, professional\-grade visual reasoning problems that evaluate advanced structural, spatial, functional, and analytical reasoning skills. Contributors will leverage real\-world technical documentation, drawings, schematics, layouts, and engineering artifacts to create benchmark tasks that can only be solved through careful visual interpretation and domain expertise. The benchmark spans multiple engineering and industrial disciplines and is intended to assess the reasoning capabilities of advanced AI systems on realistic professional workflows.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Benchmark Content Development
 



 • Create complex visual reasoning problems based on authentic industrial and engineering artifacts.
 



 • Develop tasks that require multi\-step reasoning, analysis, troubleshooting, design interpretation, planning, or decision\-making.
 



 • Ensure that the visual artifact is essential to solving the problem and that the task cannot be answered from text alone.
 



 • Design questions that emphasize structural, spatial, functional, and systems\-level reasoning rather than simple visual lookup or OCR. Problem/Solution Authoring For each benchmark item, create:
 



 1\. Problem Statement o A clear and unambiguous description of the task.
 



 2\. Visual Artifact o An authentic engineering or industrial artifact such as a CAD drawing, schematic, blueprint, floor plan, P\&ID, assembly diagram, process flow diagram, network topology, plant layout, or system diagram.
 



 3\. Final Answer o A concise, objective, and verifiable answer.
 



 4\. Worked Solution o A detailed step\-by\-step reasoning process demonstrating how the answer is derived from the visual artifact. Domains of Interest Experts with experience in one or more of the following domains are encouraged to apply:
 



  





 •
 **Mechanical Engineering** 




**• Electrical Engineering** 




**• Semiconductor Engineering** 




**• Process Engineering** 




**• Civil Engineering \& Architecture** 




**• Manufacturing Engineering** 




**• Robotics \& Automation** 




**• Utilities \& Power Systems** 




**• Aerospace Engineering** 




**• Telecommunications** 




**• Chemical Engineering** 




**• Material Science** 




**• Industrial Engineering** 




  





**Required Qualifications Education** 




 • Master's, or PhD in Engineering, Technology, Applied Sciences, Architecture, or a related discipline.
 



 Professional Experience Candidates should possess either:
 



 • 0\-3 years of relevant industry experience in engineering, design, operations, maintenance, manufacturing, planning, inspection, or system development;

title: US Proposal Specialist / Proposal Writer
description:
**US PROPOSAL SPECIALIST** 




  





 Acro Service Corporation, Bid and Proposal Team
 



  





**Experience: 3\+** 
 Years
 



**Shift:** 
**Night Shift (7:30 PM \-4:30 AM IST)** 




**Location:** 
 Noida Sector 68 (Onsite)
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Acro Service Corporation (Acro) is seeking an experienced Proposal Specialist to join its Bid and Proposal team, supporting Acro's US staffing, MSP, VMS, and workforce solutions business from India. The Proposal Specialist is a hands\-on individual contributor and full member of the proposal team, responsible for managing assigned Complex and Express RFx opportunities from initial review through final submission. This is a fast paced, high ownership role covering the full response lifecycle, from initial solicitation assessment and Go No Go input through response planning, strategy sessions, content development, reviews, and final compliance and submission.
 



 Complex RFx are large, formal solicitations, typically from state and local governments and large commercial buyers, that require a full response plan, strategy sessions, and multiple contributors. Express bids are smaller, quick turn solicitations that one person can typically assess, assemble, and submit within a few days.
 



 The role calls for strong project management, judgment, and follow through: anticipating what is needed next, following up independently with contributors, and moving assigned responses forward without continuous direction, while working within Acro's proposal SOPs and escalating when a leadership decision is required. Solicitations carry strict compliance and submission requirements, and a single missed instruction can disqualify a bid, so close reading and attention to detail are essential.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



1. **Manage assigned Complex and Express RFx responses from beginning to end.** 
 Review the solicitation, build the compliance checklist and response plan, coordinate meetings and inputs, develop the response from approved Acro content tailored to the issuer's requirements, and drive it through final submission.
2. **Contribute to Go No Go and response strategy.** 
 Conduct the initial opportunity review, facilitate assigned strategy discussions, and recommend relevant Acro capabilities, experience, and proof points.
3. **Apply proposal and workforce solutions expertise.** 
 Build working knowledge of Acro's staffing, MSP, VMS, RPO, technical and consulting, and related services; use standard content only where it actually answers the requirement; and escalate pricing, contractual, legal, or significant solution decisions to the appropriate owner.
4. **Project manage assigned responses within the proposal SOP.** 
 Own timelines, dependencies, reviews, and approvals; anticipate bottlenecks; and apply the team's checklists, templates, and quality controls consistently.
5. **Manage proposal meetings and SME contributions.** 
 Facilitate kickoff, strategy, working, and review sessions, and obtain complete input from leadership, business development, operations, finance, legal, and subject matter experts, following up persistently until it is received.
6. **Develop, tailor, and integrate proposal content.** 
 Draft and edit clear, accurate, persuasive content aligned to the evaluation criteria, and integrate input from multiple contributors into one consistent response.
7. **Ensure compliance, quality, and submission readiness.** 
 Track every mandatory requirement, form, and submission instruction, and conduct thorough final compliance and quality reviews before submission.
8. **Track and interpret solicitation changes.** 
 Monitor amendments, addenda, and Q\&A, summarize their impact, and update the response accordingly.
9. **Maintain proposal content, references, and document control.** 
 Keep proposal content, templates, references, and past performance current, and maintain SharePoint organization, version control, and RFx Tracker status for assigned bids.
10. **Support continuous improvement and team priorities.** 
 Recommend practical process and content improvements, contribute to business development collateral, and collaborate on other team responses during peak periods.



  





**Requirements** 








* Demonstrated experience managing bids or proposals from solicitation review through content coordination, compliance, production, approvals, and final submission.
* Ability to manage both quick turn and complex responses with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and shifting deadlines.
* Experience facilitating proposal kickoff, strategy, and review meetings and converting decisions into actions and content.
* Strong critical thinking and judgment, with the ability to interpret requirements and evaluation criteria, identify gaps and risks, and recommend practical next steps.
* Excellent written English with strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills, and the ability to adapt tone and level of detail to different buyers.
* Demonstrated attention to detail, including experience with compliance matrices and formal submission requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to obtain information from busy subject matter experts and drive accountability respectfully.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, including styles, tables, and templates, and working proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
* Ability to work U.S. Eastern business hours and communicate clearly and promptly with U.S. based colleagues.
* Familiarity with U.S. government procurement portals, SAM.gov, and cooperative contracts is strongly preferred.

title: Integration Support Coordinator
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
 At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
   

  

**Job Description:**
 We are a US\-based technology advisory team that runs IT integration for private equity acquisitions \- standing up network, security, identity, applications, and connectivity for newly acquired companies. We are looking for an Integration Support Coordinator based in India to work alongside us as a true team member.
   

  

 This role turns call transcripts, notes, and open action items into clean trackers, decks, and follow\-ups. Time zone overlap with the US team is limited, so you will work mostly from recordings and written context rather than live calls \- and you will be trusted to keep the plan moving without needing to be on every call.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role \- we need someone who catches issues early, keeps every workstream up to date, and makes sure open action items get closed.
   

  

 What You Will Own
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Integration Plan and Workstream Tracking**
* Maintain the master integration tracker across workstreams (network, cybersecurity, identity/devices, applications/email, connectivity, procurement)
* Update workstream status, dates, and owners after each call
* Track budget vs. actual hours by workstream and flag variances


**Call Follow\-Up and Action Items**
* Review call transcripts and recordings, extract action items, owners, and deadlines
* Log action items in the tracker and escalate stale ones
* Draft follow\-up emails and status recaps from template


**Deliverable and Deck Support**
* Build and update integration status slides for client and internal steering committee updates
* Assemble Day 1 and Day 100 plans, cutover checklists, and workstream trackers
* Maintain version control across decks for concurrent deals


**Program Management Support**
* Support running the same integration playbook across multiple concurrent acquisitions
* Track due diligence pipeline status for deals not yet in active integration
* Maintain the Context Index and file organization for integration artifacts


 What Great Looks Like:
   

  

* Turns transcripts and notes into accurate deliverables, no live call context needed
* Keeps trackers and decks current across every active deal \- no stale data
* Flags variances, blockers, and stale action items before they become problems
* Learns the playbook well enough to run it cleanly across multiple deals at once
* Communicates clearly and flags blockers or delays as soon as they come up


 What You Bring:
   

  

* 2\+ years in project/program coordination, PMO, or consulting support role \- ideally at a consulting, advisory, or professional services firm
* Comfort working from meeting transcripts and written notes rather than live call attendance
* Strong PowerPoint skills
* Comfort building and maintaining trackers, dashboards, and structured data views
* Excellent written English \- you'll be drafting emails and updates that go straight to clients
* Strong attention to detail and a low tolerance for stale or broken data
* Comfortable working independently on recurring tasks without much oversight
* Some overlap with US Eastern or Central time is preferred but not required
* Bonus: background in M\&A, IT integration, or program management


 Tools You Will Use
   

  

 Notion, SharePoint, Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel), call transcript tools (Fireflies or similar), AI (Copilot, Claude, etc.) and internal communication tools. You do not need to be an expert in all of these on day one, but you should be able to come up to speed quickly.
   

  

 We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
   

  

**Our Benefits:**
 At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
   

  

**How You Can Grow:**
 We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
   

  

**More about Crowe:**
 Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.
   

  

 Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third\-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre\-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.
   

  

 We are committed to a merit\-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job\-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

* Advance India's leadership in counter\-terrorism, governance reform, and digital sovereignty.

description:
**Programme Associate \- Industrial Heat Decarbonisation** 




  





 The International Forum for Environment, Sustainability \& Technology (iFOREST), is looking for an experienced and dynamic professional to support \& lead the organisation’s research initiatives and policy engagement in the Industrial transition and decarbonization.
 



 A successful applicant must have a proven aptitude for analytical research and multi\-stakeholder engagement, and excellent communication skills with government, industry and related agencies. The candidate should ideally have sound
 **technical and policy knowledge and experience knowledge of working in Energy Efficiency, Energy management, Boiler\-based industries, and MSME sectors such as\- Food \& beverages, Textile, Chemicals, Pharma etc. Overall knowledge of industrial decarbonization is desirable.** 




  





**Location** 
 : Sector 132, Noida, India
 



**Required Experience** 
 : 5\+ years
 



  





***About iFOREST***




 iFOREST is an independent not\-for\-profit research and innovation organisation that was established in 2019 to identify, promote and scale up solutions for pressing environment\-development challenges in India and other developing countries in Asia and Africa.
 



 Our work is rooted in regional priorities to accelerate environmental actions at the sub\-national level and to improve national policies and plans to support it. Our mission is to address the unique needs of regions by leveraging our resources and expertise to scale up national action and make a global impact. We use our regional knowledge to inform national policy and plans and strengthen international collaboration.
 



 To achieve our goals, we conduct independent evidence\-based research, develop new knowledge and innovative solutions, convene stakeholders to increase awareness and build consensus, and partner with think tanks, civil society, government agencies, philanthropies and industry to scale up solutions.
 



***The Industrial Decarbonization Programmme***




 The Industrial Decarbonization Programme is a part of iFOREST’s flagship initiative on Enabling Energy Transitions. The objective of the programme is to steer a green industry transition to support green growth and green jobs, while improving local environmental conditions and achieving climate goals. The focus is on conducing evidence\-based research, including modelling studies to develop comprehensive roadmaps, identify policy solutions and provide technical support for industrial decarbonisation in sectors like steel, fertilizer, cement, bricks and at\-risk MSME sectors, as a transition in these sectors will affect the largest number of consumers and enterprises.
 



 The Programme is strongly focused on technical research and stakeholder engagement (especially with government departments/agencies and the industry) to achieve a green transition of fossil fuel\-dependent factories that are associated with various industries.
 



***The Role***




 The Programme Associate will be responsible for the execution of research and engagement outputs pertaining to industrial decarbonisation across boiler based industries and MSME sector. This would entail conducting impactful research and multi\-stakeholder engagement, with the support of a dedicated team. In addition, they would also be expected to identify new areas of work to support institutional goals.
 



  





 Specific tasks to be undertaken are:
 



**Support and execute the research initiatives of the Programme.** 



* Contribute to designing research assignments, including developing research strategy and methodology as well as identifying specific activities and tasks.
* Conduct in\-depth primary and secondary research including quantitative and qualitative assessments.
* Remain updated with the latest tools and techniques for executing qualitative and quantitative research.
* Write research documents, including analytical reports and policy papers based on evidence.
* Mentor young researchers in in the team in executing research assignments.
* Stay abreast with the latest developments and debates in the sector.



  





**Lead the outreach and communication** 



* Design and manage a comprehensive outreach strategy for the programme as well as for projects therein.
* Enable the generation of policy\-research partnerships with government, industry and other stakeholders.
* Author and review articles and other forms of communication materials suitable for the public, government stakeholders, and donors.
* Build and leverage relationships to design and conduct roundtables, convenings, and report release meetings with government, industry, civil society, media, etc.



  





**Additional duties** 



* Contribute to shaping the overall strategy for the programme, aligned with institutional priorities, sector\-specific issues and ongoing work of other key institutions.
* Identify new pathways, initiatives, and partnerships that contribute to programmatic goals.
* Support development of new concept notes, proposals, theory of change and budgets for projects/interventions that further institutional objectives.
* Contribute to the institution’s brand building by representing iFOREST on various public platforms.
* Execute any related assignments that may arise in relation to the tasks or for further enhancement of the programme.



  





***Qualification \& Work Experience***



* A Bachelors or

title: Writer Intern
description:
**About the Role:** 




 We’re looking for a strong writer with excellent English, sharp research skills, and an eye for storytelling to join our application team.
 



 As an Admissions Content Intern, you’ll work on real student applications and help transform their academic experiences, achievements, and aspirations into compelling application narratives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Draft, edit, and refine SOPs, LORs, personal statements, university essays, and resumes/CVs under senior writer/editor guidance.
* Understand student profiles and identify their strongest stories, experiences, and differentiators.
* Convert student inputs, questionnaires, and meeting notes into clear and compelling narratives.
* Conduct university\- and program\-specific research to tailor application documents.
* Strengthen documents for structure, narrative flow, clarity, grammar, tone, and authenticity.
* Ensure documents are personalized, credible, and free from generic or AI\-sounding language.
* Incorporate feedback across multiple rounds of revisions while maintaining accuracy and consistency.
* Work closely with senior writers and counselors to develop the student’s overall application narrative and positioning.
* Manage multiple student documents and deadlines simultaneously.



  





**What We're Looking For:** 



* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Strong storytelling skills and the ability to write with clarity and personality.
* Excellent research and reading\-comprehension skills.
* Strong command of grammar and attention to detail.
* Ability to understand a person’s experiences and turn them into meaningful stories.
* Comfortable receiving feedback and rewriting extensively.
* Prior experience with SOPs, essays, resumes, college applications, or long\-form writing is a plus.
* Students/recent graduates from English, Journalism, Literature, Liberal Arts, Communications, Psychology, Management, or related fields are welcome.



  





**What You'll Gain:** 



* Internship Completion Certificate
* Exposure to top global universities including Oxford, Cambridge, Ivy League, LSE, Imperial, and more
* Hands\-on experience with SOPs, LORs, essays, and resumes rather than generic content writing
* PPO / Full\-Time Opportunity based on performance
* Performance recognition for exceptional work



  





**Internship Details:** 




**Duration:** 
 3 Months
 



**Location:** 
 On\-site — World Trade Tower, Sector 16, Noida
 



**Stipend:** 
 ₹10,000–₹14,000/month, depending on writing ability, experience, and overall profile.
 



  





**About Intelligent Education:** 




 Intelligent Education is a premium study abroad consulting firm helping ambitious students gain admission to leading universities globally. Our application team works closely with students to develop compelling, authentic, and strategically positioned application documents.
 



  





**Join Us:** 




 If you’re someone who loves writing, research, storytelling, and understanding people, this is an opportunity to build real expertise in international university applications, admissions writing, and student storytelling.
 



 Apply now to join Intelligent Education.

description:

* Strategic thinking and ability to influence diverse stakeholders.

* Collaborative, proactive, and solution\-oriented mindset.
